cRefPattern.p: Citation by the page and line of the printed edition (CAG page.line, e.g. 105.17): the line with that number after the page break with that page number.

editorialDecl.p: Text transcribed by OCR (Humanitext OCR v2, Gemini models) from the scans named in the source description. Structure (div, quote, head): assigned automatically from printed cues (Bekker references before lemmata, section numbers, headings, book titles, lecture headings; in the paraphrases, Aristotle's chapters located from the running heads) and reviewed by the editors at every boundary that was not certain. In works divided into lectures (Πρᾶξις, Θεωρία) the lectures are divs; topic headings that run across lectures (e.g. Περὶ οὐσίας) are marked milestone[@unit='topic'] and kept as text. Text: OCR of the page images (gemini-3-flash-preview; gemini-3.7-flash where it failed), collated word by word, page by page and in five-line blocks, with the First1KGreek transcription of the same edition (tlg4193.tlg012.1st1K-grc1). Lines on which the two disagreed, lines without a First1KGreek counterpart and lines containing a word form not attested in a Greek form lexicon (about two fifths of the lines) were read again from images of the single lines by a second model (gemini-3.8-flash); words still undecided were read line by line by a third model (gemini-3.1-pro-preview). A reading was adopted when the re-reading of the image agreed with it; the remaining words were decided on the page image by student assistants or by AI-assisted checking under the editor's supervision. Lines on which the OCR agreed word for word with First1KGreek and whose words are all attested were not re-read. No text was copied from First1KGreek (Open Greek and Latin Project, University of Leipzig; CC BY-SA 4.0): it served only as a collation witness, and every disagreement was decided from the page image of this edition. Spelling, accents and breathings follow the printed page: the models were instructed to transcribe exactly as printed and the checkers chose the printed form, but a normalised accentuation adopted by a model may occasionally remain. Later checks against the page images (line numbers, marginal references, signs and apparatus, omitted lines) are listed in the revision description. Headings inside a div (sub-headings, closing formulas, labels of tables) are ab[@type='head']. The words of diagrams and tables are not body text: each diagram or table is given once as figure after the last body line printed before it (labels, trees and tables transcribed; pure geometry described in figDesc); where the edition counts the rows of a diagram or table as lines, those line numbers are not used by any lb. Evident misprints of the printed edition, identified on the page image, are kept and given with the correct form as choice/sic/corr; mere variants of spelling or accentuation are left as printed. Misprinted numbers in milestones (Bekker references, old-edition page, folio, column and line numbers), which cannot carry choice/sic/corr, are given with the corrected value where the sequence of the numbers determines it. Line breaks: one lb per printed line; @n is the line count of the CAG page (headings included), resynchronised on the printed marginal numbers of the left margin; lines the edition does not count carry lb without @n. Words hyphenated across lines are joined and the lb is placed at the following word boundary. pb/@facs points to the image of the page in the Internet Archive item named in the source description (BookReader page image; for pages supplied from another copy, that copy). Critical-apparatus entries are attached to the line(s) they cite as note[@type='apparatus'] with @target on the lb (line level; the lemma words of an entry are not linked); entries that cannot be resolved remain as note[@type='footnote'] at the page end. References in the margins to older editions or manuscripts are milestone[@type='alt-edition'] with @unit and @ed (the edition identified from the preface of the volume); CAG's repetition of the current old-edition page or folio beside the first line of each page is not encoded. Bekker references printed before lemmata are milestone[@unit='bekker']. Marginal digits fused into the text by OCR have been removed.

revisionDesc.change: OCR of the page images in text mode (gemini-3-flash-preview; gemini-3.7-flash where it failed); body lines aligned to the physical lines of the page image; physical lines left without an OCR line read again (31 lines recovered in the corpus).
Line numbers anchored on the printed marginal numerals; 75 doubtful pages of the corpus checked by eye.
Automatic division into chapters, sections and lemmata; 459 uncertain boundaries of the corpus reviewed (273 removed, 119 added).

Line numbers verified against the printed marginal numerals of every page (67,352 of 70,149 numerals agreed); page-wide shifts corrected automatically (322 pages on 2026-09-26, 129 on 2026-09-28); 227 pages reviewed by student assistants (176 corrected).

Text collated with First1KGreek where a First1KGreek file could be aligned by page and line, and re-read (Gemini Batch API): 156,504 lines of the corpus by gemini-3.8-flash, 21,570 lines by gemini-3.1-pro-preview; remaining words put on review sheets.
Review sheets of the re-read words answered by student assistants; the remaining words decided on the page images.
All uncertain structural boundaries reviewed; conventions of the pilot works applied (lectures, book titles, topic headings).
Evident misprints given as choice/sic/corr; headings inside divs as ab[@type='head'].
Margin references to older editions and manuscripts encoded as milestone[@type='alt-edition'][@ed], the editions identified from the prefaces; irregular sequences checked on the page images.

Body text lost to the footnote and figure areas found by collation from the First1KGreek side and restored (about 2,300 lines in the corpus); passages missed by the OCR read again and inserted; restored and inserted lines checked again against the images.
Text of diagrams encoded as figure, and lemma Bekker references whose numbers the OCR had lost read from the images (where the work has them).

Line numbers of the 875 pages left by the verification checked on the images (248 of them also answered by student assistants), followed by a continuity check of every page; margin references to older editions checked on 2,237 page images (944 corrections).

Pages whose line numbering still had gaps or repeats checked on the images (355 pages); signs (〈 〉 [ ] † * — ( )) compared with First1KGreek and 445 pages checked on the images (313 corrections in the text, 523 in the apparatus); words hyphenated across lines joined; punctuation normalised.

Header revised (title, source description, editorial declaration, revision description); misprinted old-edition line numbers given with the corrected value where the sequence determines them; breathings and accents written as separate signs before capitals composed with the letter; missing elision marks after ἀλλ, κατ, καθ, ἐπ, δι etc. supplied in the text; numbers left at line starts removed or encoded as old-edition milestones (image checked); working row identifiers left in 37 lines removed (one line restored from the page image); words divided at a line end that had been joined to a word two lines down corrected; every body line without a line number checked on the page images (margin labels and folio marks read as lines dropped, duplicated rows removed, numbers given to lines the edition counts); numeral signs unified as ʹ (U+0374, stored in its NFC form U+02B9); line-number jumps, old-edition milestones without an edition name and notes suspected to hold body text checked on the page images; citation by printed page and line declared (refsDecl); line coordinates of the working files realigned on the marginal numerals; printers' signatures at the foot of the page removed from the apparatus; apparatus entries for two lines joined by et kept as one note pointing at both lines; page images linked from pb/@facs.

Old-edition line numbers checked on the page images where the sequence skipped a number (2,100 places in the corpus) and, page by page, where it was irregular (542 pages): numbers missed by the OCR added (549), milestones not printed on the page dropped (190; mostly the CAG's own left-margin numbers or line references of the apparatus taken for old-edition numbers), misplaced ones moved (69), misread values corrected (31), page numbers taken for line numbers made page milestones (8); the edition's own skips and out-of-order numbers left as printed, the line count printed beside the repeated page or folio at the head of a page not encoded (like the repetition).

Quotation marks made uniform: opening single and double quotation marks, printed in the edition in the reversed (high-reversed-9) form, are encoded as ‘ and “, closing ones as ’ and ”, single and double kept as printed; opening marks read by the OCR as straight quotes, low quotes or spacing breathings, and spacing breathings or quotation marks doubled before a capital that already bears its breathing, corrected.
Errors found by the accuracy evaluation (sample checked against the page images by student assistants, readings confirmed by the editor) corrected: 2 in the text and 1 in the apparatus.

οὐκ ἔστι λογικὸς ἄνθρωπος ὤν; τί δέ; ὁ Πλάτων καὶ Ἀλκιβιάδης καὶ ὅδε
καὶ ὅδε οὐκ εἰσὶ λογικοὶ ἄνθρωποι ὄντες;’ ναί φησιν. εἶτα ὡς ὁμολογούμενονφησιν om. MN
ἐπακτέον τὸ καθόλου χωρὶς ἐρωτήσεως ‘πᾶς ἄρα ἄνθρωπος λογικός.’ ἐν οἷς
τε μὴ ὀνόμασι σημαίνεται τὸ καθόλου, ἀλλὰ τῇ κατὰ μέρος ὁμοιότητι λόγῳ
τὸ κοινὸν θηρᾶται, χρηστέον πρὸς τὸ συμφέρον· οἷον ἐπεὶ τὸ κερασφόρον
μὴ ὄνομα ὂν ἀλλὰ λόγος τῷ εἶναι σύνθετον, καὶ ἐξ ὁμοιότητος ἐπὶ τὰ μὴ
τῶν ζώων ἀμφόδοντα εἴληπται, οἷον αἶγα, πρόβατον, βοῦν καὶ τὰ λοιπά,
χρηστέον ταῖς ἐπαγωγαῖς πρὸς τὸ συμφέρον, ὡς ἐπεὶ τὸ καὶ τὸ κερασφόρα
ὄντα οὐκ ἀμφόδοντα, καὶ πᾶν ἄρα· καὶ ἄλλου μὲν ἐπάγοντος αὐτὸν φέρειν
ἔνστασιν τὸν ὄνον τὸν Ἰνδικὸν ἀμφόδοντα ὄντα καὶ κερασφόρον, αὐτὸν δὲ
χρώμενον προσομολογεῖν οὕτως ἐπὶ πάντων. ἔτι χρησιμεύσει πρὸς τὸ λαβεῖν
τὴν ἀναγκαίαν πρότασιν καὶ τὸ πυνθάνεσθαι παραβάλλοντα τὸ ἐναντίον, οἷον
εἰ δέοι λαβεῖν ὅτι πάντα δεῖ πείθεσθαι τῷ πατρί, οὕτως ἐρωτητέον ‘πότερονδέει L πότερον om. MN
πάντα δεῖ πείθεσθαι τῷ πατρὶ ἢ πάντα ἀπειθεῖν;’ καὶ πάλιν, εἰ δέοι λαβεῖνδέει L
τὸ ὅτι δεῖ πολλάκις πολλὰ πείθεσθαι, οὕτως ‘πότερον πολλάκις πολλὰ πείθεσθαι

μείζω καὶ μικρὰ φαίνεται καὶ χείρω καὶ βελτίω τοῖς ἀνθρώποις.
Ἔτι δὲ σφόδρα πολλάκις ποιεῖ ἐληλέγχθαι καὶ τὸ σοφιστικὸν συκοφάντημαἐληλέγχθαι libri

αὐτῆς ἔκλινε καὶ δι’ ἐκείνων ἐθαύμασεν· οὐ γὰρ εἶχεν ἐκ τῶν κατ’ αὐτήν.
καὶ ὁ Πρωταγόρας ἐν τῷ ὁμωνύμῳ διαλόγῳ ποτὲ μὲν μύθους διέξεισι ποτὲ
δὲ περὶ ποιημάτων, ἐν οἷς εὐπορεῖν ἐπιχειρημάτων ἠδύνατο. καὶ ἐπ’ ἐκείνου·
σπεύδοντες γὰρ πρὸς ἀνασκευὴν τοῦ τὸν φιλόσοφον πολυπράγμονα εἶναι ἀντὶἀνασκευεῖν Ν

δὲ φιλίως καὶ σχετικῶς πρός τε τὴν ὕλην καὶ τὰ πράγματα διακείσεται·φιλίας καὶ σχετικῆς Μ καὶ πρὸς τὰ ΜΝ
ὁ φιλόσοφος ἄρα πρὸς τὰ τῇδε συνίσχεται. ἀλλὰ μὴν τοῦτο ψεῦδος· ψεῦδος

ἐπεὶ δὲ πολλάκις οἱ ἀποκρινόμενοι μήτε παντελῶς ἀπαρνούμενοι τὰ προτεινόμενα
μήτε διδόντες ἀπαιτοῦσι τὸν ἐρωτῶντα ἀποδεῖξαι ἣν ἠρώτησε πρότασιν,

καὶ τοῦ ὑγιεινοῦ καὶ νοσώδους ἄρα μία ἡ ἰατρική. ὃ δὲ ἀνωτέρω
